facts.fact: The Direction generale du Domaine national announced the generalisation of the Amlak information system to all cadastre, land conservation and State Domains directorates, ahead of issuing the digital land booklet (Eco Times, 25 February 2026).

Executive decree 26-15 of 7 January 2026 instituted the electronic land booklet, and the Direction generale du Domaine national announced Amlak would be generalised to all cadastre and land conservation directorates in preparation for issuing it.

DZA.note: The document says nothing about local government office connection.
